Golfer shoots 59 in final round en route to win on Korn Ferry Tour
items.description: Frankie Harris made an 18-foot birdie putt on the final hole as he shot a 12-under 59 before winning the Korn Ferry Tour's Pinnacle Bank Championship in a play-off.

items.title: Rangers midfielder Diomande set for move to Turkey - gossip
items.description: Rangers reportedly agree a £4.5m transfer to Corum for Mohamed Diomande as the Ibrox club are also linked with Aston Villa right-back Kosta Nedeljkovic.

items.description: Four pre-season games is a very small sample, but Andoni Iraola is starting to put his stamp on Liverpool. So how are the Reds shaping up under their new boss?

items.description: Michael Brennan secured his place in the FedExCup Playoffs as he won the Wyndham Championship by three strokes from Beau Hossler.

items.title: Rahm reigns again after Niemann wins LIV Golf New York
items.description: Jon Rahm clinched the LIV Golf season points title for a third straight year despite finishing tied for 41st at LIV Golf New York, where Joaquin Niemann claimed a three-shot victory for his ninth win in the last three years.

items.title: African quartet secure Women's World Cup places
items.description: Algeria, Morocco, Cameroon and Malawi all qualify for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil by reaching the semi-finals of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations.
